lockOrderSql.casResource: UPDATE dwp_deployment_startup.startup_resources SET epoch=epoch+1,phase='DRAINING',current_approval_id=NULL,row_version=row_version+1 WHERE resource_id=? AND epoch=? AND phase='SERVING' -- exactly 1 returned affected row required; overflow fails

OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dwp_deployment_startup.publication_sources s WHERE s.publication_id=p.publication_id AND s.resource_id=?)) ORDER BY p.service,p.deployment_id -- lock each corresponding current_deployments row in same connection

statements:
CREATE TABLE dwp_deployment_startup.startup_resources (
 resource_id uuid PRIMARY KEY, endpoint_id text NOT NULL, owner_service text NOT NULL,
 database_name text NOT NULL, epoch bigint NOT NULL CHECK(epoch>0),
 phase text NOT NULL CHECK(phase IN ('DRAINING','SERVING','FAILED')),
 key_revision bigint NOT NULL CHECK(key_revision>0), current_approval_id uuid,
 row_version bigint NOT NULL CHECK(row_version>=0),
 UNIQUE(endpoint_id,database_name),
 CHECK(owner_service IN ('approval','auth','notification','payroll','people','platform','provider','time')),
 CHECK(endpoint_id ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]{0,127}$'),
 CHECK(database_name ~ '^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$'),
 CHECK(phase<>'SERVING' OR current_approval_id IS NOT NULL)
);

CREATE TABLE dwp_deployment_startup.resource_approvals (
 approval_id uuid PRIMARY KEY, resource_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES dwp_deployment_startup.startup_resources,
 resource_epoch bigint NOT NULL CHECK(resource_epoch>0),
 source_artifact_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(source_artifact_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 control_reference text NOT NULL CHECK(control_reference ~ '^dwp-migration-control-v2:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 staged_manifest_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(staged_manifest_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 native_snapshot_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(native_snapshot_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 history_policy_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(history_policy_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 compiler_policy_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(compiler_policy_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 snapshot_document text NOT NULL CHECK(pg_catalog.octet_length(snapshot_document) BETWEEN 1 AND 262144),
 approved_at timestamptz NOT NULL, approval_authority_id text NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(resource_id,resource_epoch,approval_id)
);

ALTER TABLE dwp_deployment_startup.startup_resources
 ADD CONSTRAINT fk_startup_resource_current_approval
 FOREIGN KEY(resource_id,epoch,current_approval_id)
 REFERENCES dwp_deployment_startup.resource_approvals(resource_id,resource_epoch,approval_id)
 DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED;

CREATE TABLE dwp_deployment_startup.startup_publications (
 publication_id uuid PRIMARY KEY, operation_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 request_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(request_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 service text NOT NULL, deployment_id uuid NOT NULL, application_instance_id uuid NOT NULL,
 epoch bigint NOT NULL CHECK(epoch>0), permit_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 approval_id uuid NOT NULL, own_resource_id uuid NOT NULL,
 own_resource_epoch bigint NOT NULL CHECK(own_resource_epoch>0), own_resource_approval_id uuid NOT NULL,
 manifest_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(manifest_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 composite_receipt_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(composite_receipt_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 own_seal_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(own_seal_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 own_seal_document text NOT NULL CHECK(pg_catalog.octet_length(own_seal_document) BETWEEN 1 AND 262144),
 phase text NOT NULL CHECK(phase IN ('STAGED','CURRENT','REVOKED')),
 not_before timestamptz NOT NULL, expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
 key_revision bigint NOT NULL CHECK(key_revision>0), created_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
 CHECK(not_before<expires_at), CHECK(expires_at-not_before<=INTERVAL '5 minutes'),
 UNIQUE(service,deployment_id,application_instance_id,epoch),
 FOREIGN KEY(service,deployment_id) REFERENCES dwp_deployment_startup.current_deployments(service,deployment_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(own_resource_id,own_resource_epoch,own_resource_approval_id)
 REFERENCES dwp_deployment_startup.resource_approvals(resource_id,resource_epoch,approval_id)
);

CREATE TABLE dwp_deployment_startup.publication_sources (
 publication_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES dwp_deployment_startup.startup_publications(publication_id),
 source_key text NOT NULL CHECK(source_key IN ('auth','people','platform','provider')),
 resource_id uuid NOT NULL, resource_epoch bigint NOT NULL CHECK(resource_epoch>0),
 source_approval_id uuid NOT NULL,
 source_binding_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(source_binding_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 evidence_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(evidence_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 evidence_document text NOT NULL CHECK(pg_catalog.octet_length(evidence_document) BETWEEN 1 AND 65536),
 source_binding_document text NOT NULL CHECK(pg_catalog.octet_length(source_binding_document) BETWEEN 1 AND 65536),
 PRIMARY KEY(publication_id,source_key),
 FOREIGN KEY(resource_id,resource_epoch,source_approval_id)
 REFERENCES dwp_deployment_startup.resource_approvals(resource_id,resource_epoch,approval_id)
);
